outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustrating the experimental workflow, not a data plot, so the check does not apply.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows mean ± SD bars with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each condition (n=4).

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot of individual tumor volume measurements with mean and 95% CI overlaid; since every mouse's value is already plotted as an individual point, this is a scatter-type plot exempt from the requirement.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows mean ± SD bars with individual data points overlaid for control and two shRNA conditions (n=4).
Panel E is a line plot of tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make the plot unreadable.
The quantification bar chart accompanying the CD4 IHC-F micrographs shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field measured.
The quantification bar chart accompanying the pERK IHC-F micrographs shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field measured.
